compiler_snapshots.description: Builds ran on frozen snapshots of this change set as it was completed; takeover13 is the final tree. The epilogue at cap 32 was rebuilt on it and reproduced the takeover9 and takeover12 builds exactly: the same schedule, generated source and timing, with its pinned Karatsuba unit measured at 11.00 ns on its own. The other rows come from earlier snapshots and were not rebuilt. After them the compiler gained isolated measurement of pinned unit placements before a build (takeover12) and next-wider merge steps in the area search (takeover13). The cap-48 and cap-64 epilogues pin the same measured placement as cap 32, and the cap-64 prologue pins none, so the first change leaves them alone; the second narrows the search's merge moves, so their schedules can differ on the final compiler.

measurement_inputs.description: Each side starts from copies of the WireGuard build's warm synthesis store and delay cache. The final compiler measures what its scheduling decisions need; the baseline's store also received those measurements, so both schedule from the same delays.

wireguard_equivalence_gate.description: Baseline compiler, this fixture, store holding only WireGuard's measured helpers: the pass-1 epilogue schedule equals the accepted WireGuard record's
